decision.boundary: Allocator-level peak memory is unavailable on the reviewed host/process; current-allocation stage deltas and OS-level RSS high-water observations remain descriptive only.
decision.next_evidence: Obtain a peak-capable allocator measurement on a reviewed host if a portable memory claim is required; otherwise retain this explicit boundary in release documentation.

interpretation.claim: The allocator limitation is internally consistent across the two reviewed environments and can be carried as an explicit release boundary.

source.review_policy: A release boundary is ready only when two distinct environments match semantically, current allocator counters are available, and peak fields are explicitly unavailable in both.
